structural_hypothesis: An event-time self-financing two-book wealth difference can be exactly telescoped over exogenous contiguous <=72h calendar windows, keeping independently admitted quantities, native executed prices/fees, causal receipt availability, open inventory at boundaries and nonidentical fills; a local non-vacuity criterion must be explicitly tested against N9 hurdle before promoting a stochastic theorem.
null_refutation: An accepted receipt has knownAt earlier than execution effectiveAt or its decision time
The two independent books have to share fills or quantities for the identity to hold
Positive inventory disappears at a window boundary without explicit sale
One window has a nonzero unexplained wealth-difference residual beyond USD 0.000001
An out-of-order partial receipt makes cash available before knownAt
A single-window scalar range cap is claimed uniformly under nondegenerate lognormal WEAK without a stochastic tail term
An engineering example or a mathematical identity is promoted as a WEAK population profitability/infeasibility proof
candidate_lemmas: At each published mark S_t: dW_j = q_{j,t-} dS_t; at an effective fill delta_q at price P with fee F: dW_j=delta_q(S_t-P)-F. Knowledge at knownAt is tracked separately.

For two independent books A,B on the same mark tape, ΔW_end-ΔW_start= Σ(qA-qB)dS +Σ(deltaqA(S-PA)-deltaqB(S-PB)) -Σ(feeA-feeB)-Δfixed. Sum exactly across nonoverlapping <=72h windows; include positions carried over boundaries.

A one-window upper bound is the sum of positive parts of its component contributions; nonvacuity requires its normalized adjusted upper bound below the 1 bp/day hurdle for the same temporal contract, not just one favorable fixture.

The WEAK Gaussian increment has strictly positive probability of an arbitrarily large positive price ratio for every finite M, so no deterministic uniform M for a 72h local window follows from the window length alone. This is a refutation of that specific route, not all possible stochastic local bounds.

Window-crossing inventory persists and contributes to later exposure delta
Delayed receipts knownAt vs economic at; no-fill releases reservation only at knownAt
Partial target and stop exit, with original campaign <=72h lifetime
Positive OHLC and zero-tick nonnegative exit; no negative fill or borrowing

Native replay funded campaign used as one book and a separately selected valid second book; comparison never forces identical admissions
WEAK Gaussian finite-M tail counterexample; no population promotion
acceptance: Deliver either a population-valid nonvacuous native wealth inequality under all unchanged assumptions, OR a precise mathematical counterexample delimiting the infeasible local approach; retain engineering tests, failed attempts and honest nonclaim.
